additional_info.subject: ID0443361-DC/Si-D/DE-[NA]Firmware name length changes CRM:02698000421
additional_info.body:
Hello Guido, good morning.
I am taking this ticket over in order to support you.
I made a change on the FW name from "
v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+ecog-1.4.12+FileHandlerHF (PRODUCTION)" to "v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+FileHandlerHF (PRODUCTION)"
Can you please tell me if this is enough? If yes, then pleases reboot the charger and it will work.
We need to have the FileHandler in the name for monitoring purposes, but can be shorten too if necessary.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
